customer: I'm moving to Dunmore for a new job in a few weeks and I really don't have time to deal with selling my minivan on my own. I don't need another car from you, I just need this thing sold without a runaround. How does this actually work?
agent: I understand the move has a lot going on, so here's the quick version from our article "Selling your car to Northwind: how it works." You can request an offer online with your VIN or license plate, or walk into any store for a quote on the spot, then book an appraisal appointment where a specialist inspects your minivan in about 30 minutes and confirms the offer. After that you sign the paperwork and get paid, and you don't have to buy a car from us to sell one. Just keep in mind that offers last a limited time, so it's best to schedule the appraisal soon after you get yours.
